def: to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo

occurrences.text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
